Ben & Lauren — can you two propose two 45-minute slots next week that include a 15-minute pre-call with Katie (security engineer) for Kevin if he wants a tighter ops demo? Prefer morning PT windows 9:00–11:30.

Anna — from our side we'd like to surface a tentative SOW outline during that call. I've attached a draft SOW and a short run-of-show. If you want a narrower CTO/CIO-focused session, we can trim to 30 minutes and book a follow-up deep-dive.

- Tues, June 4, 9:30–10:15 PT
- Wed, June 5, 10:00–10:45 PT

Please confirm which works for you or share two preferred from the week.
